newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Northeast spot power up amid N.Y. nuke outage.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Northeast spot power up amid N.Y. nuke outage.

text.p: Spot bulk electricity prices in the northeastern U.S. rose Thursday, buoyed by a brief outage at New York Power Authority's (NYPA) 965 megawatt (MW) Indian Point 3 nuclear power plant, market sources said.
"Indian Point 3 caused a little commotion today," said a Houston trader.
Indian Point 3's output was reduced so technicians could reposition an electrical conduit in the plant's system that monitors the flow of electricity.
